behaviour: B1: on the contact profile page the add-to-group success/error confirmation renders outside the addable-groups gate (addToGroupView: showStatus = not blocked && contact && status in {success,error}; showPicker = not blocked && contact && addable>0); in the single-addable-group case the success Alert is visible after the invite.
B2: create-group-btn and create-group-submit-btn are disabled while MarmotContext.ready is false; handleSubmit no-ops when not ready.
B3: initDirectMessageCounts skips archived (blocked) contacts and drops any in-memory directMessages counter they hold; message history and last-read timestamps are never modified; idempotent.

B4: scopeInviteExpiriesToGroups(ids), called by MarmotContext.reloadGroups after loadAllGroups resolves, drops inviteExpiries counters for absent groups and keeps initInviteExpiries/incrementInviteExpiry from re-adding them; before the first call (scope null) nothing is pruned; invite-link records are never modified.
B5: decodeCard rejects a signed (v1 or v2) card with name_len=0 with error 'contactCard: signed card must carry a non-empty name'; every card encodeCard/encodeCardV2 produce still decodes.

B6: CallManager drops (silently, before the busy auto-reject) an offer whose caller isBlockedCaller and binds to no group (direct 1:1); IncomingCallWatcher wires isBlockedCaller to isBlockedPeer over a live loadBlockedPeers ref refreshed on blockedPeersRevision. Group calls are not gated.
non_goals: Block-gating group calls from a blocked member (owner question Q8).
Clearing last-read timestamps or history of blocked contacts.
Acknowledging/deleting invite-link records of absent groups.
Making createGroup await client readiness instead of disabling the control.
